title: Rancor Keeper
description: When Jabba the Hutt's cousins, the Twins, gifted Boba Fett a rancor, it came accompanied by a rancor keeper. Rancors were intelligent creatures who could be trained and required specialized care. Boba Fett informed the keeper that he wanted this rancor to be trained so that he could form a bond with it and ride it into battle. The rancor keeper obliged.
